mike: kicking off VeraCare private rollout; proposing change window 2026-04-07 02:00 UTC. need final sign-off on model pin, rollback plan, and any compliance checks.
deploy-bot: Deployment draft created: customer=VeraCare env=private region=eu-west-1 start=2026-04-07T02:00Z expected_duration=40m canary=5% runbook=/runbooks/veracare-rollout image=release-2026-04-01-abcde

sophia: i'm on for on-call that night. model pin?
jordan: pinning model to redwood-model-v1.9.3-quant (no dynamic latest). canary slice=5% on dedicated pool.

carla: VeraCare requires strict data residency — confirm no public egress and KMS keys scoped to the customer's account.
mike: confirmed: VPC peering in place, egress rules locked, KMS keys mapped to tenant key id vk-84321. ran connectivity smoke tests earlier today (10m).

sam: i've reviewed KMS policies and SGs. no public egress routes, customer key accessible by deploy role only. :white_check_mark:
sophia: rollback criteria proposal: immediate rollback if P95 latency > 700ms or error rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m, or any 5xx spike > 0.5% within 3m. rollback action = route traffic to previous dedicated slice + spin fallback CPU workers; exec script: `scripts/rollback_veracare.sh`.

jordan: will attach canary dashboards and alerts to the ticket. alerting thresholds match sophia's proposal. added runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/veracare

deploy-bot: CI status: build=2026-04-01-abcde image pushed to prod-registry tag=veracare-2026-04-01 infra-plan=applied smoke-tests=passed

carla: infra ok from my side. please ensure tracing tag `veracare-rollout` is added to all spans and logs.
mike: noted, deploy will tag traces/logs and add metadata. i'll also publish customer-facing release notes and the internal postmortem checklist.

sophia: approved for oncall and rollback plan. i'll be watching during the window. tagging escalation contact @oncall-eng.
sam: security sign-off given.
jordan: canary monitoring dashboard prepped, alert runbooks linked.

mike: scheduling confirmed. change window approved for 2026-04-07 02:00 UTC. i'll create calendar invite and add the ops-rotation.

deploy-bot: reminder: add tag `veracare-2026-04-07` to traces and logs at rollout start.

mike: thanks all — closing this thread and moving to calendar + ops checklist. will reopen if any blocking issues come up. :thumbsup:
